subfields.math/nla_approx: Numerical linear algebra and approximation: matrix factorizations, iterative and Krylov solvers, eigenvalue algorithms, interpolation, splines and basis functions, quadrature
subfields.math/pde_numerics: Numerical PDEs: finite-difference, finite-volume, finite-element, spectral and operator-splitting schemes for transport, diffusion, wave and reaction equations, including PDEs from applied fields such as finance and engineering
subfields.math/info_stats: Information theory, statistics and signal processing: entropies and channel quantities, estimation and inference, source separation and dimensionality reduction, filtering and spectral analysis
subfields.physics/quantum_info: Quantum information and computing: states, density matrices and operators, quantum channels and noise, entanglement and information measures, quantum protocols, variational and gate-based circuits
subfields.physics/quantum_mech: Single-particle and atomic quantum mechanics: bound states, scattering, time evolution of wavefunctions, mean-field and self-consistent atomic problems
subfields.physics/many_body: Quantum many-body methods: variational and diffusion quantum Monte Carlo, trial wavefunctions, exact diagonalization, tensor-network and renormalization-group methods for interacting systems
subfields.physics/condensed_matter: Condensed matter physics: band structures and tight-binding models, lattice dynamics and phonons, topological invariants, Brillouin-zone integration, response functions, spectroscopy and collective excitations
subfields.physics/optics: Optics and photonics: wave and beam propagation, Fourier optics, ray optics and aberrations, thin films and photonic structures, lasers and amplifiers, optical trapping and manipulation, wave scattering
subfields.physics/stat_phys: Statistical and nonlinear physics: lattice spin models, disordered systems, stochastic and Brownian dynamics, phase transitions, pattern formation and nonequilibrium dynamics
subfields.physics/fields_astro: Classical fields, gravitation and astrophysics: electromagnetism and field evolution, relativistic and Newtonian gravity, stellar structure, orbital and celestial mechanics, astrophysical fluids and radiation
subfields.chemistry/md: Molecular dynamics: interaction potentials and forces, periodic boundaries, integrators, thermostats and barostats, thermodynamic and structural observables from trajectories
subfields.chemistry/mc_thermo: Molecular Monte Carlo and statistical thermodynamics: canonical and grand-canonical sampling, free energies and chemical potentials, adsorption, phase equilibria, reaction equilibria and kinetics
subfields.materials/semiconductors: Semiconductor physics and optoelectronic devices: carrier statistics, band alignment and junctions, absorption and gain, quantum wells and dots, photodetectors, LEDs, lasers and solar cells
subfields.materials/structure: Crystallography and atomistic structure: lattices and reciprocal space, diffraction and indexing, structure generation, interatomic potentials, defects and mechanical properties of solids and 2D materials
subfields.biology/quant_bio: Quantitative biology: population and community ecology, consumer-resource and evolutionary dynamics, stochastic biochemical kinetics, biological sequence analysis, epidemiology and systems biology models

methods.ode: ODE integration: initial-value and boundary-value problems, Runge-Kutta and Numerov schemes, shooting, stiff solvers, eigenvalue problems for ODEs
methods.pde: Grid-based PDE solvers: finite differences, finite volumes, finite elements, spectral and split-step methods, explicit and implicit time stepping, boundary conditions
methods.stochastic: Monte Carlo and stochastic simulation: Metropolis and other Markov-chain sampling, Gillespie and kinetic Monte Carlo, Langevin and Brownian dynamics, quantum Monte Carlo
methods.particles: Particle and molecular dynamics: pair and many-body potentials, forces, neighbor handling, symplectic integrators, thermostats
methods.linalg: Matrix construction and linear algebra: building Hamiltonians or operators, eigen-decompositions, factorizations, iterative solvers, coordinate transforms and least squares
methods.quantum_ops: Quantum states and operators: tensor products, partial traces, Kraus channels, measurements, gate circuits, entropies and fidelities
methods.waves: Fourier methods and wave propagation: FFTs and filtering, propagation kernels, transfer and ABCD matrices, ray tracing, multipole and special-function expansions
methods.quad_models: Numerical integration and physical model evaluation: quadrature, special functions, closed-form physical models and device equations, building a composite model from formulas
methods.opt_discrete: Optimization, root finding and discrete algorithms: fixed-point and alternating iterations, Newton and bracketing methods, constrained or variational optimization, combinatorial enumeration, sequence and graph algorithms
